subject: Hosted API renewal — capacity and tier adjustment discussion
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@ecomify.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — hosted capacity and rate limits

Ben —

Thanks for the call earlier. We’ve reviewed our usage and forecasting and want to discuss increasing our hosted monthly commit and bumping our API rate limits for Q4. A few specifics from our side: 

- Current effective monthly commit: ~60k units (Q2 avg).
- Anticipated peak: up to 160k units/month starting Nov (holiday traffic).
- Need sustained higher RPS for inference during cache-warmup windows — currently hitting 180 rps, want to plan for 350-400 rps.

Two asks before we can sign: pricing for a 12-month upgrade to ~150k/mo committed units (and mixed-rate tiers), and whether you can temporarily raise our rate limit during the Black Friday window without a permanent change to the commit. Also procurement will want an updated quote and new invoice terms (we prefer Net 45).

Looping in procurement (Lisa Chen) on copy. Can you send a couple of options (12m annual commit vs stepped-up renewal with quarterly true-ups) and a short summary doc we can share internally?

Thanks,
Daniel

--
Daniel Park
Head of Platform
Ecomify
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@ecomify.com>
Cc: Lisa Chen <procurement@ecomify.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal discussion — hosted capacity and rate limits

Daniel / Lisa —

Appreciate the details. I put together two pragmatic options that map to the traffic patterns you described. Attached: Ecomify_Renewal_Options.xlsx and a short usage_report_Q2.csv for reference. High level: 

Option A — Annual committed (preferred economics)
- 150,000 monthly committed units (12mo term)
- Effective price: $0.0045 / unit (12% discount vs list)
- Rate limits: baseline 250 rps, pre-approved burst to 400 rps for up to 72 hours with 48hr notice
- Billing: Invoiced monthly; Net 30 default (we can set Net 45 per procurement request)

Option B — Stepped renewal with quarterly true-ups
- Start 100k/mo for first 3 months, auto-step to 150k after Q4 if usage consistent
- Effective price: $0.0049 / unit first quarter, $0.0046 thereafter
- Rate limits: baseline 200 rps, emergency bump available subject to capacity and uplift fee

Tradeoffs: Option A gives you predictable unit economics and guaranteed burst policy; Option B reduces short-term commitment but is higher unit price and has conditional bursts. 

Next steps I suggest: 
1) Tell me preferred option and confirm Net 45 if procurement requires it.
2) If Option A, I can draft an addendum for signature and request an internal rate-limit exception for the Black Friday window (we typically handle this at Sales+Infra).

If it helps, I can also arrange a 2-week trial at the 150k commit with metering so you validate the 400rps behavior before signing.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Ecomify_Renewal_Options.xlsx (spreadsheet), usage_report_Q2.csv (csv)
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@ecomify.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lisa Chen <procurement@ecomify.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — hosted capacity and rate limits

Ben —

Thanks, the options look reasonable. A couple follow-ups before we finalize: 

- Procurement would like Net 45 on the invoice and a contact for billing to set that up (cc’ed Lisa).
- Our infra team wants a temporary trial/burst test at the 400 rps target to ensure our client-side concurrency is safe. Two-week window would be great.
- Security wants confirmation that audit logs for the period will be available and retained for 90 days (they may ask for a short note).

If you can provide a brief note on the audit/log retention and confirm Net 45, we’ll decide between Option A (annual) vs the stepped approach. We’re leaning toward Option A but procurement needs the invoice tweak and the security note.

Also attaching a screenshot of our current month traffic for context (Ecomify_current_month_usage.png).

Best,
Daniel
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal discussion — Ecomify (request for Net45, burst test, audit note)

Team —

Fwd’ing the thread with Ecomify. They are very likely to take Option A (150k/mo, annual) if we can: 
- Approve Net 45 on invoicing (procurement asks).
- Grant a 72hr pre-approved burst to 400 rps for up to 72 hours during Black Friday, and allow a 2-week trial at the higher sustained RPS prior to the holiday window.
- Provide a short security confirmation on audit/log retention (90 days).

Commercial ask: I’d like to offer a one-time 10% promotional discount on the first three months to help them ramp through Q4 (we’d still be at ~10% margin with this pricing). With that discount and Net 45, I think we close quickly. If you prefer, we can make the discount contingent on a signed 12mo addendum. 

Rishi — can you ok the rate-limit exception cadence (400 rps burst + 2-week trial) from a capacity/ops risk perspective? Marissa / Lauren — can you greenlight Net 45 and the promo structure so I can send a formal addendum?

Thanks,
Ben

Subject: RE: Renewal discussion — Hosted API renewal and addendum link

Daniel / Lisa —

Great to move forward — Ecomify is approved for Option A (150k/mo, 12mo) with the following confirmed: 

- Committed units: 150,000 / month for 12 months.
- Unit price: $0.0045 / unit (annual pricing).
- Promotional: 10% credit applied to invoices for first three months to help with ramp (applies after signing).
- Rate limits: baseline 250 rps. Pre-approved burst to 400 rps for up to 72 hours with 48hr notice. We will also provision a 14-day trial at 400 rps prior to the Black Friday window — please confirm desired trial dates and expected peak test windows.
- Audit/log retention: Redwood will retain request-level audit logs for 90 days and can provide export on request during that window.
- Billing: Net 45 (procurement request honored). Finance contact: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

I’ve prepared the addendum and sent it via DocuSign for electronic signature: https://www.docusign.com/EXAMPLE/abcdef123456 (Addendum_Ecomify_2026.pdf attached here as a reference). Once signed, finance will set Net 45 and onboarding will schedule the trial window.

Next steps for you: 
1) Sign the DocuSign addendum.
2) Confirm the two-week trial window dates for us to coordinate infra.
3) Send PO if procurement requires it (we’ll match the addendum amount).

Happy to hop on a quick call to align on trial timing.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
